# betterado_workitemtrackingprocess_inherited_state (Resource)

Manages the visibility of an inherited work item state in an Azure DevOps process.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_workitemtrackingprocess_inherited_state" "example" {
  process_id        = betterado_workitemtrackingprocess_process.example.id
  work_item_type_id = betterado_workitemtrackingprocess_workitemtype.example.reference_name
  name              = "Active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the inherited state to manage.
- `process_id` (String) The ID of the process.
- `work_item_type_id` (String) The ID (reference name) of the work item type.

### Optional

- `visible` (Boolean) Whether the state should be visible.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the state.
